stimulus.text: Roanoke's colonists vanished in the late 1580s; nearly twenty years passed before England planted another colony at Jamestown.

stem: England's first attempt at a permanent American colony, Roanoke (1587), failed, and sustained English colonization did not begin until Jamestown in 1607 — more than a century after Columbus. Which broader development best explains England's late start?

options.text: England's lack of interest in overseas trade and colonization until well into the 1700s
options.misconception: England actively sought overseas trade and plunder throughout the 1500s through privateers and early ventures.

options.text: The English crown's long-standing military alliance with France against Spanish power
options.misconception: England and France were rivals, not allies, in this era.

options.text: Religious turmoil at home and a costly war with Spain
A papal decree forbidding Protestant nations from planting colonies anywhere in the Americas

instruction: Answer from the stimulus and stem only. Pick one option. Do not open the question file.
